scope: Capture-timing correction and one complete exploratory pilot; not repeated battery or catalogue qualification

diagnosis.cause: Fixed 45-second delay released the baseline without confirmation of actual profiler recording. Trace started after baseline start; native clock drift was below one millisecond.
diagnosis.fix: Run-specific capture-ready receipt, bounded 300-second wait, then 10-second settling and fresh eligibility check. Elapsed time alone never starts a baseline or inference.
diagnosis.regression: Original replay still reports incomplete coverage; corrected replay reports full coverage. Matching receipt, trace-before-release and baseline-after-release assertions pass.
diagnosis.heldGateEvidence: results/power-gated-dAW4Dv/held-gate-inventory.json contains only attach-wait marker when inspected beyond 45 seconds
diagnosis.unitTests: 10 native runtime tests passed, including new absent/late/stale/malformed/false receipt and expiry assertions; four power-analysis tests passed. Native receipt tests first failed to compile before adding the gate; saved trace supplied the independently reproduced behavioral failure.
diagnosis.limits: Gate timeout and wrong-receipt cases are unit-tested, not separately exercised for five minutes on the phone. The receipt is an operator assertion of observed capture readiness, not an automatic Instruments handshake. Final trace coverage remains mandatory.

conditions.initialReadiness: results/build12-readiness.json initially reported Low Power Mode true; later admission receipt results/build12-low-power-admission.json reported false and allowed=true. This is NOT evidence of a Low Power Mode rejection. No settings were changed by the agent.
conditions.measuredRun: Every native marker: unplugged, Low Power Mode off, nominal thermal state, brightness 1.0. Trace brightness remained 100 and the full thermal timeline was Nominal.
conditions.batteryGauge: Native battery level changed from approximately 95% to 90% in one coarse step. Retain this observation separately; it does not reconcile directly with integrated profiler rates and is not a calibrated app-only drain measurement.
conditions.chargingTable: No rows. Unplugged state corroborated by native markers and guarded completion, not by interpreting empty export as zero charging.
conditions.connection: Wireless Xcode profiling plus periodic report inventory polling; foreground app, no charging

chat.contentReview: All responses exactly match the prior manually reviewed eight-turn responses: updates retained, free entry distinct from materials budget, and 12 times two packets correctly totaled as 24. Final answer contains every requested fact.
chat.latencyScope: Generation excludes model hash/load/export; wall time brackets these harness operations but is not tap-to-render UI latency. Workload includes seven fixed 30-second reading pauses.

power.units: Rounded, explicitly labelled whole-device battery-energy percent per hour, time-weighted over each phase
power.interpretation: Full capture fixes the measurement-timing defect, not a model capability or efficiency gap. Rates describe this short whole-device experiment at full brightness with profiler overhead. No app-only attribution, baseline subtraction, promised battery life, or catalogue battery rating.
power.appImpact: 1194 rows preserved; unlabeled Swift-backed columns not assigned to CPU/GPU or converted to watts.

remaining: Repeated same-duration baseline/workload pairs and disconnected real-use checks before any battery rating. Earlier sustained-load thermal failure remains failed. One complete unequal-duration pilot is not the proposed repeated comparison.
dataScope: No shipping app changes, new model downloads, personal data deletion, or debug logs left behind. Trace and previous failures retained. App left idle; profiler stopped.
